div.mod-active.workspace-leaf.box-shadow:
inset 2px 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--nr-primary) 58%, transparent),
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--nr-primary) 16%, transparent)

.metadata-properties.box-shadow:
inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--nr-cloud) 38%, transparent),
    0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--nr-ridge) 14%, transparent)

h1[data-heading=\"This is a heading 1\"].box-shadow:
inset 1px 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--nr-pine) 72%, transparent),
    inset 6px 0 16px color-mix(in srgb, var(--nr-pine) 8%, transparent)

.status-bar.box-shadow:
inset 0 2px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--nr-pine) 42%, transparent),
    inset 0 3px 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--nr-pine) 12%, transparent)

.workspace-leaf.mod-active.box-shadow:
inset 2px 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--nr-primary) 58%, transparent),
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--nr-primary) 16%, transparent)

.markdown-embed.box-shadow:
inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--nr-cloud) 38%, transparent),
    0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--nr-ridge) 14%, transparent)

.internal-embed.is-loaded.markdown-embed.box-shadow:
inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--nr-cloud) 38%, transparent),
    0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--nr-ridge) 14%, transparent)
